passages.text: Local historians were thrilled by a recent donation. The collection of handwritten letters given to the town library last spring ______ a rare look at daily life in the 1890s, from the price of flour to the arrival of the town's first telephone.

content.stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
content.explanation: The subject of the sentence is the singular noun "collection" ("of handwritten letters" is a phrase describing it). A singular subject takes the singular verb "offers."

distractorRationales.label: B
distractorRationales.text: "Offer" is plural and doesn't agree with the singular subject "collection."

distractorRationales.label: C
distractorRationales.text: "Are offering" is plural; it agrees with "letters," which is not the subject.

distractorRationales.label: D
distractorRationales.text: "Have offered" is plural and doesn't agree with "collection."
